changeNote:
v0.5.7

Balance / 平衡性
- Underhand Strike now deals 10 damage and 6 more if the target has Block (upgraded: 12 and 8), replacing its flat 11 / 13. / 【埋伏】改为造成 10 点伤害，若目标有格挡则额外造成 6 点（升级后为 12 与 8），取代原本固定的 11 / 13。

Text / 文本
- Added the Illusionist's character voice lines, bestiary quote and combat banter. / 补齐幻术师的角色语音、图鉴引语与战斗中的对话。
- Added Illusionist dialogue for all nine Ancients. / 为全部九位先古之民补齐幻术师的对话。
- Rewrote the Mirror Image, Momentum, Shield Tax, Stargazing, Curtain Break, Mesmerizing Array, Fantasy Storm and Extract power descriptions, and gave Body Double its own description instead of borrowing Osty's. / 重写【镜像】【势头】【恃盾者亡】【候场】【破幕】【迷魂阵】【幻梦风暴】【抽离】的能力描述；【替身】不再沿用 Osty 的描述，改用自己的。
- Counts now read as proper singular/plural instead of "card(s)" / "time(s)". / 数量描述改用正确的单复数，不再显示 "card(s)" / "time(s)"。
- Unified sentence-ending punctuation across the Simplified Chinese card and power text. / 统一简体中文卡牌与能力描述的句末标点。

Fixes / 修复
- Scorching now shows the card as it burns and as the fire jumps to the next card, instead of resolving invisibly inside the draw or discard pile. / 【灼热】现在会展示被烧掉的牌以及火焰跳到的下一张牌，不再在抽牌堆或弃牌堆里无声结算。
